proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Both sides are computed by the explicit fibre recipe for the action given in the section; restricting to the opens keeps exactly the summands whose generic points lie in the opens, since the generic point of an integral subscheme meeting an open lies in it and the fibres and scheme-theoretic images are unchanged, so the two sums agree termwise (source lines 2252-2255)

core_obligations: Show (alpha cap beta)|_U = alpha|_U cap beta|_V for opens U subset X, V subset Y with f(U) subset V (proof lines 2252-2255). Both sides are computed by the explicit recipe alpha cap beta = sum n_i m_{ij} [overline{V}_{ij}] (statement of the section, lines 2211-2224): the generic point of an integral closed subscheme meeting an open lies in that open, so the summands of beta|_V are exactly those of beta with y_i in V; the fibres alpha_{y_i} and hence the V_{ij} are unchanged, and the scheme-theoretic image of V_{ij} -> X meets U exactly when it meets V's preimage, where its restriction is the image of the restricted map; hence the two recipes produce the same summands with the same coefficients and the identity holds (proof lines 2252-2254; soft-point note: the verification is the termwise comparison against the in-text explicit formula).
